en.headline: Observatory records 36.0°C, new high for the year
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory headquarters logged 36.0 degrees Celsius by early afternoon on Sunday under the influence of Severe Typhoon Dolphin’s outer subsiding air, surpassing the previous 2026 peak.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory recorded a temperature of 36.0 degrees Celsius at its headquarters by around 12.30pm on Sunday, marking the highest reading of 2026 so far.

Under the residual influence of Severe Typhoon Dolphin, mainly fine and extremely hot conditions continued across the territory. Temperatures in parts of the New Territories and other districts exceeded 37 degrees, with Sheung Shui reaching 37.4 degrees.

The Very Hot Weather Warning remained in force. The Observatory forecast extremely hot weather to persist into Monday, with some areas expected to reach 37 degrees or above, before temperatures ease slightly later in the week under a southwesterly airstream.
The Labour Department had issued a Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning earlier in the morning, advising employers to arrange appropriate rest breaks for outdoor and non-air-conditioned indoor workers.

zh.headline: 天文台錄36.0度創今年新高
zh.dek: 受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，天文台總部周日中午前後錄得36.0度，刷新今年最高氣溫紀錄，新界多區超過37度。
body: 香港天文台總部周日中午約12時30分錄得36.0度氣溫，創下2026年以來最高紀錄。
受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，本港大致天晴，日間極端酷熱。新界及多區氣溫超過37度，其中上水錄得37.4度。
酷熱天氣警告仍然生效。天文台預料極端酷熱天氣將持續至周一，部分地區氣溫可達37度或以上；其後西南氣流影響下，氣溫稍降。
勞工處今早已發出黃色工作暑熱警告，提醒僱主為戶外及無空調室內工作員工安排適當休息。
